sources.reason: New native CDA lifecycle uses the official standalone Other spec and preserves raw membership, host handoff, route application, preview, and reload assertions.

nativeCases.caseTitle: hand off a starting collection, attach its route, preview, and reload
preservedAssertions: Bounded project/generation-scoped Arango oracle selects exact Observation IDs and distinct Patient subjects.
Direct immutable-selection API membership matches the raw Observation refs and carries the Builder authorization scope.
The existing standalone selection URL ingress loads the exact revision through LoomExplorerBuilder and discovers route choices in the browser.
Native Use selected resources applies the exact subject route; the saved selection, authored columns/construction, and automatic Patient preview are checked against raw membership.
Reload retains the URL handoff, saved route, columns/construction, and exact preview; source/API freeze and required diagnostics are checked by the native CDA fixture.

runtimeEvidence.scope: Direct selection handoff, route attachment, preview, and reload; Cancel is not applicable; other route/selection variants are not covered.
